Format, lint and boundaries, lockfile integrity, immutable image pins, secret scan, typecheck, 91 unit tests, 67 contract tests, and 83 integration tests passed.

Generated TypeScript derivatives reproduce from the approved OpenAPI and runner protocol contracts.

The five US3 acceptance scenarios, bounded specification, plan and data-model decisions, tasks, implementation, tests, and evidence contain no remaining actionable gap; no task was appended and T058+ was not evaluated as current work.

ruleMatrixEvidence.passing: A complete artifact-integrity, build, test, requirement-coverage, independent-review, blocking-findings, and configured human-approval set at the expected revision is the only fixture outcome that reaches PASSED and VERIFIED.
ruleMatrixEvidence.blocking: Missing, failing, mismatched-revision, tampered, blocking-finding, and same-lineage evidence remains non-verified with explicit per-rule remediation.
ruleMatrixEvidence.claimBoundary: Artifact publication and an author claim stop at CLAIMED_COMPLETE; only the Verification Engine may perform VERIFYING to VERIFIED.
ruleMatrixEvidence.pauseResumeBoundary: PAUSE atomically marks every EVALUATING snapshot STALE before PAUSED. RESUME mints successor authority and automatically evaluates one fresh immutable snapshot; no PASSED commit can cross a later PAUSE.

artifactEvidence.storage: Owner-local content-addressed filesystem with stable metadata identity
artifactEvidence.commitIntegrityRead: The physical bytes are reread and hash-verified immediately inside verification compare-and-commit.

persistenceEvidence.records: Artifact metadata, evidence, policies, ordered rules, evaluations, immutable snapshots, reviewer lineage, and revision bindings persist transactionally with the Project aggregate.
persistenceEvidence.compareAndCommit: PostgreSQL project serialization validates policy, revision, membership, source hashes, physical artifact integrity, and Project control state before a decision is committed.
persistenceEvidence.publicationRecovery: A deterministic stable artifact identity converges filesystem publication after a database rollback without orphaning or duplicating metadata.
persistenceEvidence.resumeRecovery: The production HTTP RESUME path reuses an interrupted EVALUATING snapshot or creates exactly one deterministic fresh evaluation for a prior STALE snapshot.

resultsEvidence.truthfulness: The Results projection derives task, artifact, evidence, reviewer lineage, descriptor provenance, execution state, blocking reasons, and ordered audit data from durable state.
resultsEvidence.noCompletionInflation: Only VERIFIED renders as done; claimed, verifying, failed, stale, paused, stopped, blocked, failed-project, and cancelled outcomes remain visibly distinct.
resultsEvidence.executionParity: Every defined ExecutionState, including SUSPENDED, STOPPING, and STOPPED, round-trips through the public projection without collapsing control semantics.

idempotencyAndConcurrencyEvidence.verificationCommit: Commit idempotency is bound to the immutable project and evaluation identity; correlation identifiers remain trace metadata and do not split a semantic replay.
idempotencyAndConcurrencyEvidence.concurrentResume: Two concurrent HTTP RESUME deliveries with one semantic idempotency key and different correlation identities both return the original accepted result, create one fresh evaluation, and emit one PASSED decision.
idempotencyAndConcurrencyEvidence.pauseSupersession: A typed supersession error is swallowed only after durable reread proves that the same evaluation became STALE; divergent failures remain visible.

independentReview.reviewedRisks: Claim authority, independent lineage, immutable evidence and physical artifact integrity, PostgreSQL rollback recovery, pause/resume serialization, successor execution legality, automatic reevaluation, semantic replay, Results truthfulness, contract parity, and browser completion inflation.
